source.source_name: InfoCamere / CCIAA regional open data (Open Data Imprese Italia)

access.note: AGGREGATE statistics only — NOT a company master. Use for benchmarks/denominators.

pagination.note: Discover datasets via the DCAT catalog (data/dcat-opendata-catalog.rdf). All aggregate.

snapshot.note: Semicolon-separated; columns after the ATECO dimensions are dated count columns.

parsing.notes: Header columns after 'Divisione Ateco' are reference dates (dd/mm/yyyy) holding counts. No company id — aggregate only.

mapping_rules.benchmarks: Use counts as sector/territory denominators; this source does NOT contribute to the per-company profile.

fixture_requirements: CSV with multiple ATECO sections + divisions

live_test_plan.smoke: GET imprese-attive-ateco.csv; assert ATECO columns + at least one dated count column parse as integers.
live_test_plan.full: Harvest the aggregate datasets for benchmarks; do NOT treat as a company master.

blockers: Aggregate only — no per-company records; cannot seed the profile spine.
